module: "Dynamic Decals Tool - Browser" window of the editor's dynamic liveries tool: a central tabbed hub (Textures, Brushes, Fonts...) where other modules register their content with registerBrowserTab. Assets can be dragged and dropped onto the decal system widgets. The module is initialized by the main tool via setup(tool).
notes: Tabs are sorted by ascending order (1000 by default).
registerEditorPreferences and editorPreferenceValueChanged are empty functions (body commented out).
In onGui, the variable textureBrowserCurrentTab is overwritten at each iteration and has no visible effect.

onGui.desc: Draws the window and its tab bar by calling the guiFn of each tab. Registered by setup() as the "browser" editor callback.

registerEditorPreferences.desc: Editor preferences hook: currently does nothing.

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes: currently does nothing.

setup.desc: Initializes the module: gets the extensions editor_api_dynamicDecals, editor_dynamicDecals_textures and editor_dynamicDecals_docs, registers the window (800x400), the "browser" UI callback and the "Browser" documentation page.

registerBrowserTab.desc: Adds a tab to the browser and re-sorts the list by order.

guiFn.desc: ImGui function drawing the tab content

isWindowVisible.desc: Indicates whether the window is visible.
